title: Contraction parameter bounded by a square-root exponent ratio
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q\ge0$ satisfy $p\ge1$ and $q>1$, let $\rho<1$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Suppose the uniform $q$-norm of $x\mapsto a+\rho bX(x)$ is at most the uniform $p$-norm of $x\mapsto a+bX(x)$ for all real $a,b$, and suppose the uniform expectation of $X^2$ is positive. Then $\rho\le\sqrt{(p-1)/(q-1)}$.
hypotheses_covered: The defining hypercontractive inequality holds for all real $a,b$
The uniform expectation of $X^2$ is positive
